title: CausalGuard-FL: Causality-Guided Backdoor Defense for Federated Medical Vision–Language Models in Sepsis-Associated Acute Lung Injury

claims.claim: 448 by 448 frontal radiographs, report truncated to 256 tokens, clinical variables encoded
claims.reason: Raw image, report and clinical preprocessing and the clinical encoder are not implemented; the available loader accepts precomputed features.

claims.claim: Qwen3-VL with clinically adapted frozen image and report towers
claims.reason: Exact tower extraction, adapter configuration, and adapted weights are not supplied; the implementation address could not be accessed.

claims.claim: Agreement uses cosine similarity and elementwise product; 64 clean-data centroids
claims.reason: The embedding concatenation is an engineering choice; centroids are supplied externally. Their clean-only fitting and the clinical tower features were not verified.

claims.claim: Sum over mediator assignments and batch-averaged conditional outcome distributions
claims.reason: The explicit arithmetic was checked previously. Squared-distance soft assignment, neural head, temperature and arithmetic averaging are engineering defaults; the paper also mentions a normalized weighted geometric mean without specifying its formula.

claims.claim: Sum across silos of squared gradient of risk with respect to scalar multiplier at one
claims.reason: The scalar-gradient expression was checked previously; applying it to task logits and selecting non-invariant mediator coordinates are not specified by the manuscript.

claims.claim: Project the weighted mean client update orthogonally to the masked disagreement subspace
claims.reason: The projection expression was checked previously; selection of the mask and MAD-based spectral threshold is not defined precisely enough to implement without an additional assumption. Rank and mask must be supplied.

claims.claim: Task plus 0.5 times front-door loss plus 0.1 times invariance loss
claims.reason: Weights match the manuscript. The task head and loss are engineering choices; no clinical training was performed.

claims.claim: Sepsis-3 cohort and Berlin-criteria moderate or severe injury within 72 hours
claims.reason: Clinical records and adjudicated labels are restricted.

claims.claim: Patient-held-out test data separated before poisoning
claims.reason: Study partitions were not available; patient separation has not been verified on the clinical cohort.

claims.claim: Image, report and dual-key attacks assessed separately
claims.reason: Attack generation and clinical held-out evaluation are absent. The non-target denominator is an engineering definition and is not confirmed by the paper.

claims.claim: Three-level accuracy and ten-bin expected calibration error
claims.reason: Clinical evaluation and remaining metrics are not implemented.

claims.claim: Reported baseline comparisons, ablations, uncertainty, reader and prospective analyses
claims.reason: The required baselines, study data and statistical procedures are not present.

claims.claim: Training schedule, optimizer, learning rate, batch size, seeds, compute, Qwen adaptation and codebook fitting
claims.reason: The manuscript does not specify these sufficiently and the official implementation could not be accessed.
